researcher_notes: OPUS REDO PASS. Blind independent re-extraction of the 3 Grenzebach datasheets in Datasheets/AGV_AMR/Analysed/. No sonnet-era findings consulted. All 3 products already exist in the DB; all 3 came out as 'conflict'. Scope discipline: L1200S/OL1200S extracted against scope '*' + 'Logistics:AGV' + 'Logistics:AGV:AMR'; FF1200S against '*' + 'Logistics:AGV' + 'Logistics:AGV:Forklift'. SEE company_wide_context AND the scope-bug block below — the existing DB rows carry a substantial number of out-of-scope field values.

field_sources.country: all three files, back-page imprint: 'Grenzebach Maschinenbau GmbH, Albanusstraße 1, 86663 Asbach-Bäumenheim / Hamlar, Germany'

company_wide_context.applies_to: Company record only (both fields are scope '*', entity Company). DB already holds country=DE — confirmed, not a change.
company_wide_context.notes: All three sheets also print a second address 'Grenzebach Corporation, 10 Herring Road, Newnan, Georgia, USA'. This is a US subsidiary/sales entity, not a service_coverage statement — no service_coverage value derived from it (AP0 service_coverage allowed_values are EU-country codes plus 'Global'/'None'; the document does not claim either). Fleet software is named 'Grenzebach Fleet Manager' in the OL1200S brochure (p.4 SOFTWARE block, p.5 'VDA 5050-COMPATIBLE' block); IIoT platform named 'SERICY' (OL1200S p.4) — neither maps to an AP0 field beyond fleet_management_system, see per-product notes.

products.variant_group: L1200S family. The OL1200S brochure (p.4) explicitly presents 'OL1200S' and 'L1200S' side by side as two distinct vehicles ('OL1200S: with omnidirectional drive ... L1200S: trusted classic with conventional drive'), so L1200S and OL1200S are separate products, NOT variants of one chassis. Whether 'L1200S-Li' (this datasheet) is a separate SKU from the plain 'L1200S' in the DB is unresolved — see conflicts.

field_sources.min_ground_clearance: p.2, spec row 'Height (lifting plate down) 340 mm' — per AP0 hint, min_ground_clearance holds the ROBOT HEIGHT needed to drive under the carrier ('Source: vehicle height spec'), corroborated by p.2 prose 'Due to its low construction height, the L1200S can tunnel under a variety of different load carriers'
field_sources.min_turning_radius: p.2, spec row 'Turning radius  Pivot in stationary location or ≤1m' — label explicitly says 'Turning radius' (not Wendekreis/diameter), so mapping is safe per the established rule; '≤1 m' is an upper bound so 1000 mm is the conservative value for this KO_IF_GT field. Converted m→mm (printed '≤1m' → 1000 mm). SEE NOTES — the sibling OL1200S brochure prints '≥1 m' for the same row.
field_sources.navigation_type: p.2, spec row 'Navigation  Contour navigation (safety scanner detects surrounding and compares with internal map)' + p.2 prose 'Due to the free contour navigation'. AP0 navigation_type hint maps 'contour-based' → 'Natural Feature (SLAM)'.

products.notes: CONFLICTS (existing DB values NOT overwritten): (1) max_speed DB=2.0 m/s vs datasheet 1.0 m/s (p.2, stated twice — unloaded AND loaded rows). (2) vehicle_length DB=1263 vs datasheet 1238 mm (p.2). (3) vehicle_width DB=695 vs datasheet 693 mm (p.2). All three DB values are close-but-not-equal, which is the signature of a DIFFERENT VARIANT rather than a transcription error — this file is titled 'L1200S-Li' (lithium version) throughout, while the DB row is plain 'Grenzebach L1200S'. Note however that the DB row already carries battery_type=LiFePO4, i.e. it is already described as the lithium version, which argues against the two-variant explanation. Not resolvable from this corpus. NB the DB's max_speed=2.0 exactly matches the FF1200S sheet's 2.0 m/s — a cross-product copy is a plausible alternative explanation. PLAUSIBILITY FLAG: min_ground_clearance=340 mm exceeds config/plausibility.json's required_min_ground_clearance max of 300 mm. The value is read verbatim from the sheet and is a vehicle-height figure, so it is not a read error — the plausibility ceiling appears to be tuned for low-profile under-ride AMRs and this vehicle is 340 mm tall. Recorded as-is, flagged. NOT MAPPED: 'Total weight 300 kg' (no AP0 field), 'Operating voltage 48 V DC' (no AP0 field), 'Sound pressure level < 69 dB (A)' (no AP0 field), 'Drive mode Forward and reverse' (no AP0 field; it does confirm omnidirectional_movement is NOT claimed for this model — left null rather than false, since absence of a claim is not a denial). 'Battery charging system Fixed contact, up to 80 A charge rate' — deliberately did NOT map to autonomous_charging: fixed charging contacts strongly imply automatic charging, but the document never states unattended/automatic charging, and Blank≠Zero cuts both ways. Options listed on p.2 ('Area monitoring', 'Blue Light') have no AP0 equivalent.

products.notes: CONFLICTS (existing DB values NOT overwritten): (1) navigation_type DB='Inductive Loop' vs datasheet 'Contour navigation' → 'Natural Feature (SLAM)' (p.2 spec row AND p.2 prose, stated twice independently). The DB value is directly contradicted by the document — nothing anywhere in this sheet mentions wire guidance or inductive loops. (2) infrastructure_free DB=0 (false) vs datasheet-supported true — same source, and a direct consequence of (1). (3) operating_temp_min DB=5 °C vs datasheet 10 °C standard / 0 °C on request (p.2) — the DB's 5 matches NEITHER figure. (4) operating_humidity_max DB=70 % vs datasheet 80 % (p.2). SCOPE BUG IN EXISTING DB ROW (pre-existing, not introduced here — same class as the recurring wrong-scope pattern): this product is product_type='Forklift AGV', yet the DB row carries values for six fields that exist ONLY in other vehicle-type scopes — turning_radius (1450), route_type ('Flexible Route') and route_programming ('Map-based') are all scope 'Logistics:AGV:Tugger'; workflow_capability ('Transport'), grid_required (0) and picking_mechanism ('None') are all scope 'Logistics:AGV:AMR'. Note the turning_radius=1450 does match this sheet's p.2 row 'Turning radius Approx. 1,450 mm' — the number is right but there is NO valid AP0 field to hold a turning radius for a Forklift AGV, so this pass deliberately did not extract it. Flagged for DB cleanup, not corrected here. NOT MAPPED / left null on purpose: drive_type (sheet never states counterbalanced/reach/straddle — DB has 'Straddle Stacker', not contradicted, just unsourced here); stacking_capability (sheet says it transports pallets to a 1,200 mm lift height but never states stacking/de-stacking — DB has 1, not contradicted); load_type (sheet says only 'pallets and similar transport goods', no EUR/ISO/size named — DB has 'Pallet EUR|Pallet ISO', not contradicted); min_aisle_width (no aisle/corridor width stated anywhere — DB has 2800, unsourced here); load_detection (p.2 options list 'Autonomous load carrier detection' but never names the sensing technology, so no allowed_value can be picked); mast_type (not stated). 'Communication 5G (default WLAN is always available)' (p.2) and 'Operating voltage 48 V DC' have no AP0 field. p.2 option 'Spare battery available' is suggestive of battery_swap_capable but does not state hot-swap — left null.

products.notes: CONFLICT (existing DB value NOT overwritten): lift_height DB=60 mm vs datasheet 140 mm (p.4, 'Lifting height Approx. 140 mm (5.51 in), electrical', with an internally-consistent imperial conversion). The DB's 60 mm is exactly the L1200S's lifting height (see the L1200S-Li entry in this same findings file, p.2 'Lifting height 60 mm') — this looks like a value copied from the sibling product rather than an independent measurement. Recommend correcting to 140. DOCUMENT SELF-CONTRADICTION / TURNING-RADIUS AMBIGUITY (deliberately left NULL, flagged): p.4 spec row reads 'Turning radius  Pivot in stationary location or ≥1 m (3.3 ft)'. Two problems. (a) '≥1 m' is a LOWER bound, which is unusable for a KO_IF_GT field — no conservative value can be derived from it. (b) The identically-structured row on the sibling L1200S-Li sheet (p.2) reads '≤1m' — the two sheets print opposite inequality signs for the same phrasing, so at least one is a typo, and there is no way to tell which from these documents. (c) Both rows simultaneously assert 'Pivot in stationary location', which under the AP0 hint ('0 if omnidirectional') would give 0 — and this vehicle IS explicitly omnidirectional (p.3, p.4). Three mutually incompatible readings; min_turning_radius left null. This is the same class of radius/diameter/semantics ambiguity that keeps recurring across suppliers in this corpus. NOT MAPPED (no suitable AP0 field / axis not stated): the ±250 mm load-carrier misplacement tolerance stated three times (p.2 'within a variance range of up to 250 mm (9.8 inches)', p.2 'within a tolerance range of +/- 250 mm (9.8 inches)', p.3 'within a variance range of +/– 250 mm (9.8 inches)') is conceptually a pick_req_accuracy value, but the source gives a single undirected figure and AMR scope offers only pick_req_accuracy_dep and pick_req_accuracy_angle (no _lat) — assigning it to an axis would be inventing information, so it is recorded here in prose only. Also unmapped: 360° 3D vision minimum detectable obstacle size ~50 mm (p.3); 'Galvanic isolation as per DIN EN 1175 (VDE0117)' (p.4) — DIN EN 1175 is an electrical-equipment standard and is not in AP0 safety_standard's allowed_values; total weight approx 580 kg; operating voltage 48 V DC; sound pressure < 69 dB(A). PLAUSIBILITY FLAG: min_ground_clearance=330 mm exceeds config/plausibility.json's max of 300 mm — same situation as the L1200S-Li (verbatim vehicle-height figure, not a read error). SCOPE BUG IN EXISTING DB ROW (pre-existing): this product is product_type='Mobile AMR' but the DB row carries vna_capable=0 and route_type/route_programming — vna_capable is scope 'Logistics:AGV:Forklift', route_type and route_programming are scope 'Logistics:AGV:Tugger'. Neither is valid on an AMR. The same applies to the L1200S row (vna_capable, stacking_capability, route_type, route_programming). DATA-QUALITY FLAG (all three Grenzebach DB rows): fleet_management_system is stored as 'Proprietary (Fleet Manager)', which is NOT one of AP0's allowed_values for that field ('Proprietary', 'Open API', 'VDA 5050 compatible', 'Third-party WMS native'). This pass left fleet_management_system unset rather than guess between 'Proprietary' and 'VDA 5050 compatible' — the OL1200S brochure supports both readings (proprietary Grenzebach Fleet Manager AND an open VDA 5050 interface), and the AP0 hint's NULL RULE explicitly warns against inferring this field from the mere presence of fleet software or a VDA 5050 mention.
